C0837.title: A 158-Year-Old Company Destroyed Overnight: Employee's Weak Password Guessed by Hackers, All Data Locked
C0837.summary: In 2023, the century-old British transport firm KNP fell victim to the Akira ransomware group after hackers guessed an employee's weak password and breached internal systems, encrypting all business data. The hackers did not name a price, but a ransomware negotiation firm estimated the sum could reach £5 million. Unable to pay, KNP lost all data and went under, with 700 employees losing their jobs.
